scope: Exactly 1,000 sourced electronic device model/SKU records dated 2015–2026; not 1,000 physical inventory units or completed transactions.

sources.name: Apple Support model identification articles
sources.license_note: Factual product metadata extracted with source attribution; no open-license claim for Apple text or images. Image URLs point to original manufacturer assets.
sources.year_semantics: Manufacturer year introduced, or explicit year in the named model generation.

sources.name: ENERGY STAR Certified Computers V9.0
sources.year_semantics: First available-on-market date in listed markets. Certification date is not used as release year.
sources.notes: Some records identify exact regulatory model numbers rather than consumer marketing names. Certification wildcard families are excluded. No EPA certification logo is reproduced.

sources.name: ENERGY STAR Certified Televisions
sources.year_semantics: First available-on-market date in listed markets.

sources.name: Historical GSMArena phone specifications mirror
sources.publisher: foykes; original factual specifications from GSMArena
sources.license_note: The mirror does not specify an explicit redistribution license. The academic deliverable uses selected factual specification records with original attribution; it does not claim the data or source images are CC0 or independently owned.
sources.year_semantics: Released year from Status; if not stated, announced year from Announced. The basis is explicit per row.
sources.notes: Historical 2021 snapshot, not evidence of 2026 inventory or market prices. Source price text remains only as historical_price_text in specs and is never used as a live price. Rumored/cancelled/coming-soon entries are excluded.

sources.name: TP-Link and ASUS dated router/mesh launch announcements
sources.license_note: Selected factual model names and announcement dates are attributed to original manufacturer pages. No open license is claimed for articles or images.
sources.year_semantics: Announcement year, not an assumed retail availability date. Availability and specifications can differ by region.
sources.notes: 40 explicitly named real router or mesh models. Concepts without subsequent product identity, USB/PCIe adapters and generic speed classes are excluded. Direct urllib access to the ASUS Canada 2020 article returned HTTP500; its factual model/date information was independently verified by official-page web retrieval and retained in a small factual evidence JSON.

sources.name: CellphoneS Vietnamese product listings and technical pages
sources.year_semantics: Only an explicit product model year or release date in the actual source is accepted. Unknown years are not guessed.
sources.price_semantics: Retailer asking/listing prices observed on 2026-11-02, not completed transaction prices, not manufacturer MSRP, and not promised future prices.
sources.notes: Quotes are separate rows from model identities. Storage/condition variants retain their own evidence. Manufacturer dates take precedence over an identified conflicting retailer field. No invented stock, seller identity, review count or rating is added.

field_missing_policy: Unobserved values are null or omitted. Unknown prices remain null. No fabricated release date, current price, user rating, sales count or claimed stock is substituted.
refresh_policy: Run original acquisition scripts and review schema/source changes before rebuilding. Regeneration is deterministic for the same retained source snapshots.
